continuous_text.title: My Family
continuous_text.content:
My family, my family!
This is my family.
He's my brother
And she's my sister.

My dad, my mom!
My sister, my brother!
We have so much fun!
I love them.

My family, my family.
I love my family!
I love them,
And they love me.
I love my family!

continuous_text.title: A Big Family
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1:
Maria: Is this your photo album, Tim?
Tim: Yes, this is my family.
Frame 2:
Maria: Who are they?
Tim: They're my parents.
Frame 3:
Maria: How many brothers and sisters do you have?
Tim: I have one brother and one sister.
Frame 4:
Tim: Who's she?
Tim: She's my sister.
Maria: Oh, she's Jane!
Frame 5:
Maria: And who's he?
Tim: He's my brother.
Frame 6:
Maria: Patrick!
Tim: Yes, Patrick!
continuous_text.notes: Frames 1-4 on p. 28; frames 5-6 on p. 29; track 50

continuous_text.title: Content Connection: Family Picture
continuous_text.content: This is a picture of my family. Look at the boys. They're my brothers. The girl is my friend. She's my best friend. Her name's Mia. This man is my dad. This is my mom, and the baby is my baby sister! Her name's Anna. This woman is my grandma. I love my family!

continuous_text.title: Grammar Reading: Amy's Family
continuous_text.content:
This is my family. Look at my grandma. Her name's Anne. This is my grandpa. His name's Bob.
The woman is my mom. Her name's Emma. This is my dad. His name's Joe.
I have a brother and a sister. His name's Pete, and her name's Megan.
This is me. My name's Amy.

continuous_text.title: Culture Connection: Family and Friends
continuous_text.content:
1 Maria is a girl. She's my friend. She's my best friend. She's from Mexico.
2 Minjoon is my friend, too. He's a boy. He's seven. He's from South Korea.
3 My sister is ten. I love my sister. Her name's Celine. She's from France. I'm from France, too!
4 I love my family, and I love my friends, too.
